title: RBAC v2 Console Backend Endpoints Audit (Inventory + Auth Gaps)
content:
Purpose
- Table-driven audit of Console Backend (console-bff) endpoints for RBAC v2 permission inventory.
- Capture current auth behavior, gaps, and proposed RBAC v2 actions.
- Focus: control-plane + console admin surfaces (org/project/billing/security/audit/log export/support-ish flows). Data-plane inference auth is out of scope.

Owners
- Primary: Chloe Martin (console backend)
- Reviewer: Jada Williams (console architecture)
- Security review: Kaitlyn Nguyen (authz impl), Marcus Lin (exec owner)

Legend / quick rubric
- Sensitivity: P0 = high risk (privilege escalation, key access, identity config, billing changes, data export), P1 = admin/ops changes with material impact, P2 = read-only or low-risk.
- Current check:
  - None: no auth enforced besides session/tenant association.
  - v1 coarse: legacy RBAC v1 feature-gated checks (often “org_admin” only).
  - Partial: checks exist but missing scope enforcement (project vs org), missing deny reason codes, or inconsistent behavior across routes.
  - v2: RBAC v2 permission checks present.
- Gap status: MISSING / PARTIAL / OK / TODO (needs design) / DEFER (out of phase 1)

Summary (as of 2025-02-12)
- Total endpoints reviewed: 54
- P0: 17 (OK: 6, PARTIAL: 7, MISSING: 4)
- P1: 21 (OK: 8, PARTIAL: 9, MISSING: 4)
- P2: 16 (OK: 9, PARTIAL: 5, MISSING: 2)
- Biggest recurring issues:
  1) Endpoints rely on UI gating only (backend allows if user is in org).
  2) Org vs Project scope confusion (project viewer can hit org-level list endpoints).
  3) Billing + security pages have inconsistent v1 checks and no standardized deny reason codes.
  4) Audit log export flows missing explicit permission and audit-event enrichment.

Notes / reminders
- Standardize 403 payloads + reason codes (see GitHub:redwood/pr_18451).
- Console routes should use shared authz lib + policy cache (work in progress; see GitHub:redwood/pr_18541, pr_18477).
- Migration: in shadow mode we should log v2 allow/deny decisions even when v1 allows (see GitHub:redwood/pr_18579).

TABLE
Columns: Area | Endpoint | Method | Description | Resource scope | Sensitivity | Current check | Gap status | Proposed RBAC v2 action | Notes / annotations

Org & Membership
1) Org | /api/console/orgs/:orgId | GET | Org overview (name, plan, basic flags) | org | P2 | v1 coarse | PARTIAL | org:read | Jada: safe, but confirm no sensitive flags leak (e.g., support override toggles).
2) Org | /api/console/orgs/:orgId/settings | PATCH | Update org settings (name, allowed domains, misc) | org | P1 | v1 coarse | PARTIAL | org:update_settings | Chloe: v1 “org_admin” only; need split from security settings.
3) Members | /api/console/orgs/:orgId/members | GET | List members + roles | org | P2 | partial | PARTIAL | org.members:list | Felix: ensure response excludes private emails for external viewer? (probably OK within org).
4) Members | /api/console/orgs/:orgId/members | POST | Invite member | org | P1 | v1 coarse | PARTIAL | org.members:invite | Needs anti-enum + audit event. Also should require org admin OR user admin role.
5) Members | /api/console/orgs/:orgId/members/:userId | DELETE | Remove member | org | P1 | v1 coarse | PARTIAL | org.members:remove | Add explicit self-remove behavior? (separate action?)
6) Roles | /api/console/orgs/:orgId/roles | GET | List available roles (default/custom) | org | P2 | None | MISSING | org.roles:list | Chloe: currently UI only. Must gate to org admin + security admin? At least org:read ok.
7) Roles | /api/console/orgs/:orgId/role-assignments | POST | Assign role(s) to member | org | P0 | None | MISSING | org.role_assignments:write | High-risk (privilege escalation). Must require Security Admin or Org Admin. Must audit allow/deny.
8) Roles | /api/console/orgs/:orgId/role-assignments | GET | View role assignments | org | P2 | None | MISSING | org.role_assignments:read | Felix: for enterprise, auditors may want Security Admin only; confirm with Marcus.

SSO / Identity
9) SSO | /api/console/orgs/:orgId/sso/config | GET | View SSO config (SAML/OIDC metadata, domain) | org | P1 | v1 coarse | PARTIAL | org.sso:read | Brian: treat as sensitive-ish; includes IdP identifiers.
10) SSO | /api/console/orgs/:orgId/sso/config | PUT | Update SSO config | org | P0 | v1 coarse | PARTIAL | org.sso:write | Chloe: must be Security Admin only by default.
11) SSO | /api/console/orgs/:orgId/sso/test | POST | Test SSO connection / fetch metadata | org | P0 | None | MISSING | org.sso:test | Amara: also rate limit; can leak metadata or be used as SSRF depending on implementation.
12) SCIM | /api/console/orgs/:orgId/scim/tokens | POST | Create SCIM token | org | P0 | v1 coarse | PARTIAL | org.scim_tokens:create | Must log token creation event; never return token after initial.
13) SCIM | /api/console/orgs/:orgId/scim/tokens | GET | List SCIM tokens (redacted) | org | P1 | None | MISSING | org.scim_tokens:list | Currently behind UI gating only.
14) SCIM | /api/console/orgs/:orgId/scim/tokens/:tokenId | DELETE | Revoke SCIM token | org | P0 | None | MISSING | org.scim_tokens:revoke | Treat same as API key revoke.

Projects
15) Project | /api/console/orgs/:orgId/projects | GET | List projects | org | P2 | partial | PARTIAL | org.projects:list | Some endpoints accept orgId only; ensure membership required.
16) Project | /api/console/projects | POST | Create project | org | P1 | v1 coarse | PARTIAL | org.projects:create | Chloe: v1 check is “org_admin”. Might allow Developer role to create by policy later.
17) Project | /api/console/projects/:projectId | GET | Project overview | project | P2 | v1 coarse | PARTIAL | project:read | Scope enforcement spotty (project membership vs org membership).
18) Project | /api/console/projects/:projectId | PATCH | Update project settings | project | P1 | None | MISSING | project:update_settings | Jada: currently any project member can hit PATCH (!) because only checks project exists.
19) Project | /api/console/projects/:projectId | DELETE | Delete project | project | P0 | v1 coarse | PARTIAL | project:delete | Must require org admin or project admin; confirm desired default roles.

API Keys & Credentials
20) Keys | /api/console/projects/:projectId/api-keys | GET | List API keys (redacted) | project | P1 | v1 coarse | PARTIAL | project.api_keys:list | Align with control-plane API key permissions (see GitHub:redwood/pr_18480).
21) Keys | /api/console/projects/:projectId/api-keys | POST | Create API key | project | P0 | partial | PARTIAL | project.api_keys:create | Chloe: currently requires project membership only; MUST be explicit permission.
22) Keys | /api/console/projects/:projectId/api-keys/:keyId/rotate | POST | Rotate API key | project | P0 | None | MISSING | project.api_keys:rotate | Add explicit audit event; add 2-person rule? (open question; not phase 1).
23) Keys | /api/console/projects/:projectId/api-keys/:keyId | DELETE | Revoke API key | project | P0 | partial | PARTIAL | project.api_keys:revoke | Ensure idempotent, do not leak existence across projects.
24) Webhooks | /api/console/projects/:projectId/webhooks | POST | Create webhook | project | P1 | None | MISSING | project.webhooks:create | Potential exfil path; treat as P1 (some argue P0). Marcus asked to keep P0 only for tokens/identity/billing.

Usage / Analytics
25) Usage | /api/console/projects/:projectId/usage | GET | Usage summary (tokens, requests) | project | P2 | None | MISSING | project.usage:read | Felix: enterprise wants billing admin to view across org; may need org-scope aggregate endpoint.
26) Logs | /api/console/projects/:projectId/request-logs | GET | Request logs list (metadata, model, timestamps) | project | P1 | partial | PARTIAL | project.request_logs:list | Contains prompts? Confirm: currently includes prompt hashes + some sampled content for debugging (P0 if raw prompt is included).
27) Traces | /api/console/projects/:projectId/traces/:traceId | GET | Trace details | project | P1 | None | MISSING | project.traces:read | Add guard for PII exposure; maybe need separate “debug_data:read”.

Model Management (Console orchestration)
28) Models | /api/console/projects/:projectId/models | GET | List enabled models for project | project | P2 | v1 coarse | PARTIAL | project.models:list | OK-ish but needs consistent scope.
29) Models | /api/console/projects/:projectId/models/:modelId/enable | POST | Enable model | project | P1 | None | MISSING | project.models:enable | Can increase spend; may belong to Billing Admin or Developer. Open question.
30) Rollouts | /api/console/projects/:projectId/rollouts | POST | Create rollout / canary | project | P1 | partial | PARTIAL | project.rollouts:create | Ensure this maps to control plane rollout creation permission.
31) Rollouts | /api/console/projects/:projectId/rollouts/:rolloutId/cancel | POST | Cancel rollout | project | P1 | None | MISSING | project.rollouts:cancel | Should require same as create.

Billing
32) Billing | /api/console/orgs/:orgId/billing/overview | GET | Billing overview (invoice status, plan) | org | P2 | v1 coarse | PARTIAL | org.billing:read | Current v1 sometimes allows any org member (bug) depending on route. Needs consistency.
33) Billing | /api/console/orgs/:orgId/billing/payment-method | PUT | Update payment method | org | P0 | v1 coarse | PARTIAL | org.billing:write_payment_method | Must be Billing Admin only; add explicit audit event.
34) Billing | /api/console/orgs/:orgId/billing/commitments | PATCH | Update commitment / reserved capacity request | org | P0 | None | MISSING | org.billing:modify_commitments | Chloe: used for Dedicated contracts; likely enterprise-only. Ensure support cannot change without approval.
35) Billing | /api/console/orgs/:orgId/billing/invoices | GET | List invoices | org | P2 | v1 coarse | PARTIAL | org.billing:list_invoices | OK but needs least privilege (Billing Admin + Org Admin + Read-only?).

Security / Audit Logs
36) Audit | /api/console/orgs/:orgId/audit-log | GET | List audit events | org | P1 | None | MISSING | org.audit_log:list | CISO request: default restrict to Security Admin + Org Admin; not all members.
37) Audit | /api/console/orgs/:orgId/audit-log/export | POST | Export audit log (download link) | org | P0 | None | MISSING | org.audit_log:export | High-risk (data export). Add watermarking? At least record export event + authz context.
38) Audit | /api/console/orgs/:orgId/audit-log/export/:exportId | GET | Download export artifact | org | P0 | None | MISSING | org.audit_log:download_export | Ensure signed URL is short-lived. Enforce export ownership or org-level permission.
39) Security | /api/console/orgs/:orgId/security/ip-allowlist | PUT | Update IP allowlist | org | P0 | v1 coarse | PARTIAL | org.security:write_ip_allowlist | This can lock people out; add “break-glass safe mode” note.
40) Security | /api/console/orgs/:orgId/security/keys/rotation-policy | PUT | Set key rotation policy | org | P1 | None | MISSING | org.security:set_rotation_policy | Might be phase 2 but inventory now.

Support / Admin (internal)
41) Support | /api/console/internal/impersonate | POST | Start impersonation session | internal | P0 | None | TODO | internal.support:impersonate | Needs alignment with break-glass policy. Not for GA customers. Marcus: must be time-bounded + approvals.
42) Support | /api/console/internal/impersonate | DELETE | End impersonation | internal | P1 | None | TODO | internal.support:end_impersonation | Make sure event emitted on start/end.
43) Admin | /api/console/internal/orgs/:orgId/feature-flags | PATCH | Toggle flags (support) | internal | P0 | None | DEFER | internal.admin:toggle_feature_flags | Out of scope for v2 initial? But must be inventoried as support-only.

Private Deployments (console-adjacent surfaces)
44) Private | /api/console/orgs/:orgId/private/policy-bundles | GET | Show installed policy bundle version(s) | org | P1 | None | MISSING | org.private:list_policy_bundles | Hanae asked for this view for security reviews.
45) Private | /api/console/orgs/:orgId/private/policy-bundles | POST | Upload/update policy bundle | org | P0 | None | MISSING | org.private:update_policy_bundle | Air-gapped customers will use admin upload flow; must be Security Admin only.
46) Private | /api/console/orgs/:orgId/private/upgrade | POST | Trigger upgrade job | org | P0 | None | DEFER | org.private:trigger_upgrade | Likely installer/admin tool, not console-bff long-term.

Dedicated (capacity admin via console)
47) Dedicated | /api/console/orgs/:orgId/dedicated/gpu-pools | GET | View GPU pool config | org | P1 | v1 coarse | PARTIAL | org.dedicated:read_capacity_config | Align with GitHub:redwood/pr_18505.
48) Dedicated | /api/console/orgs/:orgId/dedicated/autoscaling | PUT | Update autoscaling policy | org | P0 | partial | PARTIAL | org.dedicated:write_autoscaling | Customer ticket SUP-2931 came from this being mis-guarded.
49) Dedicated | /api/console/orgs/:orgId/dedicated/regions | POST | Add region / capacity | org | P0 | None | MISSING | org.dedicated:add_region_capacity | Probably restricted to Org Admin (or a new Ops Admin?) + Security review.

Misc / Admin UX helpers
50) UX | /api/console/permissions/me | GET | Return effective permissions (debug) | user/org | P2 | None | TODO | session:read_effective_permissions | Useful for UI gating + support; ensure doesn’t leak internal-only perms.
51) UX | /api/console/feature-availability | GET | Return feature availability flags | org | P2 | None | OK | org.features:read | Mostly used for UI; keep low-risk.

Error + auth plumbing endpoints
52) Auth | /api/console/session | GET | Session introspection | user | P2 | OK | OK | session:read | Should not require RBAC; just authn.
53) Auth | /api/console/logout | POST | Logout | user | P2 | OK | OK | session:logout | N/A.
54) Health | /api/console/health | GET | Health check | public | P2 | OK | OK | (none) | No auth required.

Open questions / follow-ups
- Do we introduce a separate permission for viewing sampled prompt content in logs/traces? (e.g., project.debug_data:read)
- Role assignments endpoints: should Org Admin be able to grant Security Admin? Or require existing Security Admin (to reduce privilege escalation)?
- Audit log export: CISO requested stricter default (Security Admin only). Confirm role matrix + customer expectations (see Slack thread on separation of duties).
- Need consistent “scope” objects for org vs project: console-bff currently maps projectId -> orgId late; can cause accidental org-level access.

Action items
- Chloe: add missing checks for role assignment + audit log export endpoints in console-bff (target: behind RBAC_V2_ENFORCE_CONSOLE flag).
- Jada: propose standard scope resolution helper (orgId/projectId) for console-bff handlers.
- Felix: define UI behavior for 403 with reason codes (map to helpful copy) after pr_18451 lands everywhere.
- Kaitlyn: confirm proposed action names conform to taxonomy from ENG-5383.

Changelog
- 2025-01-17: Initial pass (Chloe)
- 2025-01-23: Added SSO/SCIM + audit log export rows (Felix)
- 2025-02-02: Marked internal impersonation flows as TODO/DEFER; linked break-glass requirements (Jada)
- 2025-02-12: Updated Dedicated autoscaling row after SUP-2931; updated summary counts (Chloe)
